territorial_scope.description: Applies to state entities and their contractors for business uses involving the State of Kansas.

evidence.quote: This policy applies to all business use cases involving the State of Kansas

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Sets acceptable-use rules for generative AI across Kansas executive-branch agencies and their contractors: mandatory human review of outputs, bans on certain uses and inputs, contract disclosure and data-restriction terms, and controls on AI-generated software code. Originally issued 19 May 2023 per its history note.
summary.long: Kansas Policy and Procedures Memorandum 8200.00 is the primary governing document for generative AI use by state entities (executive-branch agencies, boards and commissions under the Governor, and their agents and contractors). It covers all business uses involving the State. Its stated purpose is protecting the State's safety, privacy and intellectual property rights. Generative AI outputs must be reviewed by human operators for accuracy, appropriateness, privacy and security before use, and may not be used verbatim, assumed accurate, used as sole source, used for official statements, or solely relied on for final decisions. Restricted Use Information and inappropriate or copyrighted material may not be entered as input. Agency contracts must require contractor disclosure of generative AI use and bar contractors from using State RUI or confidential data in generative AI queries or proprietary training unless the agency head approves after consulting the Chief Information Security Officer. Generative AI-generated software code may be implemented only after business and security risks are mitigated, and must be annotated. Heads of entities must set compliance procedures. The text contains no penalty provisions.

relations.note: Defines Restricted Use Information (RUI) by reference (8.2). Section 9.2.3 bars RUI from generative AI interactions and refers to ITEC Policy 7230A Section 9.16 (Account Management - RUI). Section 9.2.8 also refers to RUI.

evidence.quote: Restricted Use Information as defined in ITEC 7230A.

relations.target_text: State of Kansas Social Media Policy
relations.note: Section 9.2.4 applies the standard of the State Social Media Policy to information submitted to generative AI. Section 7.2 also lists the Social Media Policy as a reference.

evidence.quote: subjected to the same standard as referenced in the State Social Media Policy

notes: Executive-branch policy memorandum (PPM 8200.00, Generative AI Policy). The text states no legal basis, amended or repealed instrument, or transposed act. Both cross-referenced documents (ITEC Policy 7230A and the State of Kansas Social Media Policy) are named only by title and are not in the registry, so target_instrument_id is empty. The only date is the original issue date of 19 May 2023 (Sec. 11.0); no revision date is given, so the version is unclear. Sec. 11.0 refers to '#8200.00' while the document is titled a 'Generative Artificial Intelligence Policy'.
